turns.learner: Hello! Can you give me an exercise on the past simple with -ed?
turns.tutor:
You already know how regular verbs work in the past: finished actions take -ed, as in "We visited a museum on Saturday." So let us make it a bit harder and see how you handle the details.
Write two sentences about last weekend. Use two different regular verbs, and make one of them a verb where the spelling changes before -ed, such as one ending in -y or a short verb that doubles its last letter.
